name: @agentic-toolkit/adh-registries
description: The Registries feature: the owner's explorer over the registries a workspace built, and the registrant's editor for their own listing in one.
comment:tier: VOCABULARY, not mechanism — see scripts/check_boundaries.py. This package imports @agentic-toolkit/adh-registry (the fleet's site catalogue) and @agentic-toolkit/adh-ui, so it must carry the `adh-` prefix to sit on the right side of the guard's line. That is not a workaround for the boundary, it is what the feature IS: a registry can be BOUND to a fleet site, its slugs are refused against every fleet site's reserved list, and the public address it promises an owner at create time is a fleet host. Those three facts are adh vocabulary, and a version of this feature with them injected would be three seams that every host fills identically — duplication wearing a seam's clothes. The registry MECHANISM (the API client, the field widgets, the profile renderer) stays in @agentic-toolkit/registry, mechanism, where a non-adh host can still use it. The directory is `features/` only because the tsup/vitest presets live there.
comment:exports: `development` → src for `next dev` (HMR); prod skips it → dist. The barrel is `use client` and tsup hoists that directive over the chunk, so `./parse` — the URL grammar, plain functions — gets its own directive-free entry: a Server Component page can ask what a path selects without pulling the editor onto the client.
